hook: Blood proteins flagged diabetic kidney disease up to a decade before albuminuria appeared.
summary: Measuring 5,420 blood proteins in 830 adults with type 1 diabetes, the authors found 130 linked to kidney outcomes over 10 years, 59 of which replicated in another cohort. KIM-1, GFRA1, CD14 and GDF15 predicted albuminuria years ahead. Genetic analysis suggested some proteins as drug targets. These are associations in one disease cohort, so they do not show the proteins cause damage.
title: Comprehensive proteomics reveals stage-specific signatures in blood that precede diabetic kidney disease onset and progression
